name: Every Good And Perfect Gift
overview: Scripture reveals that every good and perfect gift comes from an unchanging and faithful God who does not lie or repent, ensuring His promises are fulfilled (Numbers 23:19; Malachi 3:6). The Lord, who is eternal and steadfast (Psalms 102:27), generously provides what is good and fruitful (Psalms 85:12) out of His enduring mercy (Psalms 136:7). He alone holds all wisdom and light, sovereign over all mysteries, and from Him flow all blessings that sustain and enrich life (Daniel 2:22).
